sourceFile: 9. BRS-161016(GMI) Report TEST  new dry machine 15.10.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are too mixed for final Ask AI use.
issues: Primary changed factor mixes machine validation, jig material, dry time, temperature, and assembly type.
Old Jig baseline is only a narrow 22.10 context and is not valid for all cited conditions.
No-change judgement ignores differing temperature, dry time, and repeated test conditions.
Measurement outcomes cite headers or summary-like rows rather than the raw supporting rows.
Sheet1 Normal vs test measurements are not integrated with the dry/glue outcome context.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the case be framed as new dry machine validation or jig material optimization?
Which condition is the intended baseline: normal machine, old jig, or prior dry process?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor around one primary context and keep date/jig/temp/time as subgroup keys.
Separate 22.10 old-vs-new jig comparisons from earlier FR/material trials unless justified by source context.
Recalculate outcomes only for rows sharing comparable temperature, dry time, type, and date context.
Replace header-only evidence with cited result rows supporting each metric or measurement.
Review Sheet1 context before including dimensional measurements in the same case.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but many are insufficient or misgrouped for final evidence.
